description: Test implementation of a mock Plugin API for Mattermost, including methods for setting failure states, managing key-value pairs, and logging errors.

classes.name: mockPluginAPI
classes.description: A mock implementation of the Plugin API used for testing, with methods to simulate failures and manage key-value data.

methods.name: newMockPluginAPI
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of mockPluginAPI with initialized key-value store.

methods.name: setFailing
methods.description: Sets the failing state of the mock API to simulate errors.

methods.name: setFailingWithPrefix
methods.description: Sets a prefix for which the API will simulate errors on keys starting with that prefix.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all key-value pairs stored in the mock API.

methods.name: KVGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key, possibly returning an error if in failing state.

methods.name: KVDelete
methods.description: Deletes a key-value pair, possibly returning an error if in failing state.

methods.name: KVList
methods.description: Lists keys with pagination, possibly returning an error if in failing state.

methods.name: KVSetWithOptions
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair with options, supporting atomic updates and error simulation.

methods.name: LogError
methods.description: Logs an error message with optional key-value pairs.
